title.narrative: NCIC-Interpeace Marsabit County Peacebuilding Programme- Stabilisation Phase

description.narrative: The proposed project is aimed at urgently reducing the tensions and violence in Marsabit County, in the short and medium terms, with a focus on election-fuelled violence and the development of an infrastructure that will support peace, over a period of two years. It is Interpeace¿s belief that a long-term peacebuilding engagement is necessary to eradicate the impact of the root causes of the conflict; the proposed project will put in place the building blocks for, and identify the solutions which can lead to, the development of a longer-term programme.

project recordsQuality control comment August 2023 This values of 2326 605 female and 1721 male has been set to 0. Final report. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.

title.narrative: 1) Number of violent conflicts in the targeted area of the Action

description.narrative: 13 major violent incidents were recorded by ACLED between October 2020April 2022. This is significantly lower than the actual incidents that were happening as incidents of violence have been experienced daily with the conflict shifting from pastoral areas in the outskirt to gun battles seen in Marsabit town.

comment.narrative: This is significantly lower than the actual incidents that were happening as incidents of violence have been experienced daily with the conflict shifting from pastoral areas in the outskirt to gun battles seen in Marsabit town.
No Incident of major violence has been recorded in Marsabit apart from sporadic livestock thefts and tension on the cross border after one incident in Ethiopia in the last 4 months.
